stock.description: MediNet Group Limited, an investment holding entity, delivers a wide array of medical and dental services to corporations, insurance companies, and private individuals across Hong Kong and the People's Republic of China. The company manages two MediNet Centres, providing general practitioner consultations, immunization programs, men's health services, and comprehensive health assessments and body check-ups. Its operations also encompass six dental clinics, which offer a full spectrum of oral care, from routine services like scaling, polishing, fillings, and intra-oral X-rays, to advanced treatments such as cosmetic dentistry, orthodontics (including Invisalign), restorative solutions (dentures, veneers, implants), and oral and dental laser implant surgery, catering to both plan members and self-paying clients. Furthermore, MediNet operates a dedicated DNA genetic laboratory. The group also extends its services to include physiotherapy, traditional Chinese medicine practitioners, vaccinations, X-ray and diagnostic laboratory tests, and various specialist medical consultations. Additionally, MediNet utilizes online platforms to facilitate the sale of dental and medical consultation services. Established in 1994, the company is headquartered in Causeway Bay, Hong Kong, and operates as a subsidiary of MediNet International Limited.
